profile.headline: Senior Software Development Engineer · Machine Learning Engineer · Artificial Intelligence Engineer · Data Scientist
profile.summary:
Core Specialties

Firmware Development:
=================
* Microcontroller Architecture: Expertise in DSPic microcontrollers for intelligent device design and development.
* Compiler Environments: Skilled in using MikroElektronika tools, including MikroBasic, MikroC, and MikroPascal, for seamless, efficient firmware development.

Application Development
=================
* Web & Windows Applications: Proficient in creating user-centered web and Windows applications to enhance interaction and accessibility for end-users.
* Interface Design: Emphasis on intuitive, user-friendly designs that prioritize user experience and ease of use.

Mobile Development
=================
* Cross-Platform Competency: Development of mobile applications for Windows phones, Android devices, and Windows CE embedded devices, ensuring optimal functionality and compatibility.
* Embedded Mobile Solutions: Specialized in crafting applications for embedded systems, facilitating field operations and device control.

Data and Statistical Analytics
=================
* Data Processing & Transformation: Expertise in preparing and transforming large datasets for insightful analysis and decision-making.
* Statistical Modeling & Analysis: Skilled in applying statistical techniques and models to derive actionable insights and optimize system performance.
* Visualization & Reporting: Proficient in data visualization tools and reporting systems for clear, data-driven presentations that support strategic decisions.

Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence
=================
* End-to-End ML/AI Pipeline Creation: From data preprocessing to model building and evaluation, experienced in developing robust machine learning pipelines from scratch.
* AI for Robotics: Skilled in designing and implementing algorithms tailored for robotic systems, enhancing autonomy and intelligent behavior.
* LLM & AI Integration: Proficient in integrating large language models and AI-driven features into applications, enabling advanced data analysis and enriched user interaction.

GenAI and AI-Driven Automation
=================
* GenAI Agent Development: Expertise in building Generative AI agents for automating tasks, increasing efficiency, and reducing manual workload.
* AI-Enabled Chatbots: Skilled in designing and deploying conversational AI solutions for enhanced customer engagement and user support.
